'''Granite''' is a [[Minerals#Geode Minerals|mineral]] that can be found in the [[Geode]] and the [[Omni Geode]].

==Gifting==
{{GiftsByItem
|dislike=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo
|like=Wizard
}}

==Bundles==
Granite is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Despite its description, granite is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Granite is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt122|link=Tailoring{{!}}Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a gray dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
One Granite may be requested by a [[Spook Fish]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 7.

==History==
{{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]]. Can be requested in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]].}}
